# Power

`c.Power` calls the API's Power group. Reboot or shut down the host.

## Methods

| Method                                        | Returns                              | Permission      | Description         |
| --------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------ | --------------- | ------------------- |
| [`Reboot(ctx, hostname, input)`](#reboot)     | `*Response[Collection[PowerResult]]` | `power:execute` | Reboot the host.    |
| [`Shutdown(ctx, hostname, input)`](#shutdown) | `*Response[Collection[PowerResult]]` | `power:execute` | Shut the host down. |

### Reboot

```go
func (s *PowerService) Reboot(
	ctx context.Context,
	hostname string,
	input PowerRebootInput,
) (*Response[Collection[PowerResult]], error)
```

Reboot the host.

Runs shutdown -r -- +N, with N the delay in whole minutes and at least one, so
the agent can answer before the host goes down. A message goes to the logged-in
users. Each run changes the host.

It sends `POST /api/node/{hostname}/power/reboot`, and needs the permission
`power:execute`.

The examples of the method's definition:

In one minute, `go run power.go reboot`:

```go
resp, err := c.Power.Reboot(ctx, target, client.PowerRebootInput{})
```

In five minutes, with a message, `go run power.go reboot-2`:

```go
resp, err := c.Power.Reboot(ctx, target, client.PowerRebootInput{
	Delay:   300,
	Message: "maintenance",
})
```

### Shutdown

```go
func (s *PowerService) Shutdown(
	ctx context.Context,
	hostname string,
	input PowerShutdownInput,
) (*Response[Collection[PowerResult]], error)
```

Shut the host down.

Runs shutdown -h -- +N, with N the delay in whole minutes and at least one, so
the agent can answer before the host goes down. A message goes to the logged-in
users. Each run changes the host.

It sends `POST /api/node/{hostname}/power/shutdown`, and needs the permission
`power:execute`.

The examples of the method's definition:

In one minute, `go run power.go shutdown`:

```go
resp, err := c.Power.Shutdown(ctx, target, client.PowerShutdownInput{})
```

In five minutes, with a message, `go run power.go shutdown-2`:

```go
resp, err := c.Power.Shutdown(ctx, target, client.PowerShutdownInput{
	Delay:   300,
	Message: "maintenance",
})
```

### RowStatus

What happened on the host: ok, the operation ran and succeeded; failed, it ran
and did not succeed; skipped, the host's OS family does not support it; timeout,
the host did not answer, so nobody knows whether it ran.

A `string`, one of `ok`, `failed`, `skipped`, `timeout`.
